findings.original_ledger_excerpt:
319. A reboot regression was repaired but the fix was not reboot-tested
Batch: 7778 | Execution: 2026-09-28__23-27-33 | Severity: Operational observation
Task: port-forward-ansible-rhel10-7778
Problem: Node2 reboot caused a firewalld-zone regression and the published application became unreachable. The playbook was corrected, but the subsequent restart round rebooted other nodes instead of node2. The persistence of the fix on the node that failed remained unverified.
Why a production administrator should care: The final observed deployment cannot be treated as recovered. Preserve an independent management/rescue path and require final service/data checks.
